author: Praxis I
title: MoE with Task-Specific Regularization for CRI-Off
abstract: This submission refines the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model by introducing task-specific hyperparameters. While the MoE approach of using a simpler 1D CNN for the CRI-Off task improved results, the model still underperforms, likely due to overfitting to noise. This experiment applies stronger regularization specifically to the CRI-Off model by instantiating it with a smaller hidden dimension and a higher dropout rate. This is a targeted test to see if reducing model capacity and increasing regularization for this single outlier task can improve its performance without affecting the high-performing models on other datasets.
